zombie: Shambles straight at you and claws; the basic dead of every night.
z_headless: A zombie with no head: no headshots, it just keeps clawing.
z_dread: A tougher, darker zombie that soaks a little more damage.
z_dread_headless: The headless dread kind: tougher and no head to aim for.
runner: Sprints at you and swings fast; dies quicker than the rest.
z_deranged2: A runner variant: fast, frantic swings, a little frailer.
z_deranged_headless: A headless runner: fast and no headshot to stop it.
tb_mangled: Our own Thriceborn: a torn-up walker that grabs and claws.
tb_foul: Our own Thriceborn: a rotting walker, slow and steady.
tb_putrid: Our own Thriceborn: putrid flesh, the night-two walker.
tb_malignant: Our own Thriceborn: tougher, darker walker from night 3.
tb_relentless: Our own Thriceborn: tougher and a step faster; keeps coming.
tb_dread_putrid: Our own Thriceborn: the toughest walker, much more health.
rag_draugr: A ragged draugr with an old blade: slow cuts, early fodder.
rag_restless: A restless draugr: a little tougher, still slow.
sk_rotten: A brittle skeleton: quick, weak, falls apart in a hit or two.
sk_bloody: A blood-soaked skeleton, a touch tougher than the rotten ones.
death_hound: A Dawnguard death hound: runs you down and bites; low health.
death_hound2: A feral death hound: faster and tougher, hunts in packs.
boneman: A Soul Cairn boneman: a sword-and-shield skeleton.
marksman: A boneman archer: shoots from range (a summon, not in the pool).
boneman_warrior: A boneman warrior: heavier armour, more health.
necro: A skeleton that throws firebolts from range (raised by casters).
hexer_rime: A skeleton that throws ice spikes and slows you (raised by casters).
hexer_storm: A skeleton that throws lightning, drains magicka (raised by casters).
sk_necromancer: A skeleton caster that raises other dead (a summon).
mage: A novice necromancer: hangs back, throws bolts and raises skeletons.
apprentice_necro: An apprentice necromancer: casts and raises the dead.
cultist: A Miraak cultist: casts from range; humans come from night 10.
nightwalker: A feral vampire: fast, leaps in and drains you.
bloater: A hulking draugr: big, slow, hits very hard; 1.8x health.
rag_scourge: A draugr scourge: tougher, two-handed swings.
rag_champion: A draugr champion: tough, heavy blows.
rag_reaper: A draugr reaper: heavy greataxe swings, lots of health.
king: A draugr lich: casts frost and shouts, raises the dead (special).
ancestor_ghost: A spectral ancestor: ghostly, chills with each hit.
draugr_ghost: A malevolent draugr ghost: hard to see at night, cold hits.
brute: A Draman brute: winged daedric beast, huge hits; 2x health.
frost_brute: A frost brute: icy hulk, slow and very tough.
ash_spawn: An ash spawn: burns you with each blow, rises from ash.
ash_immolator: An ash immolator: fire bursts around it; tougher.
werewolf: A werewolf: charges and mauls, knocks you about.
wereskeever: A wereskeever: fast rat-beast, quick bites.
sk_raider: A furred skeleton raider: tougher melee skeleton.
sk_reaver: A skeleton reaver: heavier armour, harder hits.
adept_necro: An adept necromancer: stronger spells, more raised dead.
prophet: An Ardent prophet: a strong caster, keeps its distance.
reaper: A skeleton reaper berserker: frenzied two-hander, 2.5x health.
draugr_guardian: A draugr guardian: heavy armour, blocks and bashes.
draugr_reaper: A draugr reaper: big sweeping swings, lots of health.
wrath_brute: A wrath brute: a Soul Cairn hulk that pounds the ground.
hybrid: A vampire hybrid: winged, fast and tough.
true_hybrid: A true-blood hybrid: the stronger hybrid, drains and slams.
clannfear: A clannfear: a fast daedric lizard that charges and bites.
daedroth: A daedroth: big crocodile daedra, breathes fire, hits hard.
hunger: A Hunger: a fast daedra that drains your stamina as it claws.
dremora_kynval: A dremora knight: armoured sword fighter, casts fire.
dremora_markynaz: A dremora lord: heavier armour and harder magic.
expert_necro: An expert necromancer: strong frost and raises more dead.
master_necro: A master necromancer: the strongest raiser of the dead.
soul_wraith: A soul wraith: a floating spirit that casts and drains.
draugr_overlord: A draugr overlord: heavily armoured, shouts, 2x health.
draugr_reaper_ov: A draugr reaper overlord: the toughest draugr in the pool.
asc_lich: An ascended lich: frost spells and raised dead (special).
mythic_lich: A mythic lich: the strongest lich (special).
shadow: A skeleton reaper warlord: an elite with a black lunge and shriek.
valkynaz: A dremora valkynaz: a daedric lord caster (special).
winged_twilight: A winged twilight: flies in and strikes with its claws.
elder_daedroth: An elder daedroth: bigger and tougher daedroth.
ogrim: An ogrim: a giant daedric bruiser, slow, huge blows.
arch_necro: An arch necromancer: the top caster (special).
knight: A draugr dragon knight: a mini-boss in dragonbone.
mb_deathlord: A mini-boss: skeleton deathlord, heavy two-hander.
lich: A mini-boss: ancient lich, frost storms and raised dead.
mb_vargrbrute: A mini-boss: giant werewolf that leaps and mauls.
mb_minotaur_lord: A mini-boss: minotaur lord, charges and gores.
mb_giant_brute: A mini-boss: giant berserker, club sweeps that knock you flying.
mb_daedroth_lord: A mini-boss: daedroth lord, fire breath and bites.
mb_ogrim_lord: A mini-boss: ogrim lord, the biggest daedric bruiser.
mb_bone_wrath: A mini-boss: bone wrath, a giant skeletal hulk.
mb_wrathman: A mini-boss: the Wrathman, a fast spectral swordsman.
mb_mistman: A mini-boss: the Mistman, vanishes in mist and strikes.
mb_nether_lich: A mini-boss: nether lich, floating caster.
skeleton: The skeleton the casters raise: weak, fast, many.
volatile: A feral vampire the noise draws at night.

priest_draugr2: A city's Dragon Priest (draugr): casts and calls the dead.
priest_ancient: A city's ancient Dragon Priest: stronger spells.
priest_ancient2: A city's ancient Dragon Priest: stronger spells.
priest_mythic: A city's mythic Dragon Priest: the strongest priest.
priest_draman: A city's Draman priest: a daedric-draugr caster.
priest_draman2: A city's Draman priest: a daedric-draugr caster.
sk_rag: A ragged skeleton with old gear: early melee.
sk_rag_restless: A restless rag skeleton: a little tougher.
rag_wight: A draugr wight: cold blows, tougher than rag draugr.
draman_restless: A restless Draman skeleton: daedric-boned melee.
rag_guardian: A draugr guardian in rags: blocks and bashes.

sk_imperial: An Imperial skeleton soldier: sword and shield.

blade_novice: An undead Blade: katana fighter, quick cuts.
sk_ghost: A malevolent skeleton ghost: see-through, cold hits.
sk_rag_scourge: A skeleton scourge: heavier two-handed swings.

blade_journeyman: An undead Blade journeyman: faster katana combos.

wyrm_vo: Act III dragon of the third word: undoing.
echo_alduin: The final boss on the Throat of the World.
mel_skel_berserker: A skeleton berserker: wild two-handed swings.
mel_skel_hero: A skeleton hero: sword and shield, steady.

mel_wight_berserker: A wight berserker: cold two-handed swings.
mel_wight_hero: A wight hero: cold blade and shield.
mel_draman_serpentine: A Draman serpentine: a fast daedric-boned fighter.
